description: This file contains the implementation of a MySQLi database class within the Opencart system, handling database connection, queries, SSL setup, and session configuration.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A class encapsulating mysqli database connection, queries, and SSL handling within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQLi connection with provided options, sets SSL if specified, and configures session parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns either a result object for SELECTs or a boolean for other queries.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last write operation.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last auto-increment ID generated after an insert.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection and removes temporary SSL files upon object destruction.
